title: Eye of Time
description: A surreal dark fantasy illustration features a large central blood-red eye with a blue iris containing three silhouetted figures. A grandfather clock with exposed roots merges with the eye, while a vibrant orange phoenix flies above. To the right, a purple-robed hooded figure holds a book beneath a banner reading 'EYE OF TIME - CENTURION ECHO'.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy artwork on black background, a giant red veined eye with blue iris containing three white silhouettes at center, grandfather clock with gnarled roots growing from it, fiery orange and red phoenix flying in upper left, purple hooded robed figure holding a book on the right, banner text 'EYE OF TIME - CENTURION ECHO', floating clock faces and gears in background, shooting star and blue silhouette figure, intricate line art mixed with vibrant color accents
